subject: maths
question: Rakesh travels the first 320 km by train at a speed of 80 km/hr and the next 250 km by bus at 50 km/hr. Ignoring the buffer time between different modes of travel, the average speed (in km/hr) for his tour was:
solution:
**Given:**

Distance traveled by train = 320 km

Speed of train = 80 km/hr

Distance traveled by bus = 250 km

Speed of bus = 50 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance / Total time

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculations:**

Time taken by train = Distance traveled by train / Speed of train

⇒ Time taken by train = 320 / 80

&rArr
